newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria says Israel trying to shake Mideast stability.
newsitem.headline: Syria says Israel trying to shake Mideast stability.

text.p: Syrian Interior Minister Mohammad Harba accused Israel of blocking the peace process and seeking to destabilise the Middle East, official sources said on Monday.

"Current Israeli practices and efforts are aimed at blocking the peace process...and at shaking the security and stability of the region," they quoted Harba as telling Libya's Minister of Justice and Public Order Mohamed Higazi.
Harba said Syria was committed to peace but it should be based on Israel's withdrawal from lands captured from Arabs, including the Golan Heights taken from Syria in 1967.

The sources said Higazi reiterated Libyan support for Syria "in its struggle to achieve the just peace that would ensure the return of the usurped Arab rights and achieve stability and security in the region."
Israel's air force intelligence chief said on Sunday the probability of war with Arabs could no longer be characterised as low, and Syria remained "Israel's number one confrontation state".
